demo.title: Chameleon UI inner demo
demo.kicker: Phase 1 internal — not the public docs site
demo.galleryLead: Official components, primitives, themes, and i18n. Theme switch sets data-theme; Arabic sets dir=rtl from language.
demo.adaptiveHint: Resize the browser: narrow windows get a TabBar, wide windows a sidebar. Layout follows window/container width — do not click to switch.
demo.alertBody: Status color comes from the active theme tokens.
demo.popoverBody: Popover content follows the document direction.
demo.threeEndLead: Not a token swap. One live AppShell / TabBar / Sidebar / Dialog / ActionSheet filling the window. Drag the browser from about 390 → 768 → 1280 and the chrome morphs. Do not click to switch ends.
demo.threeEndCupertinoFrost: Cupertino is frosted glass, not a palette swap: nav bar, tab bar, and dialogs use saturate()+blur() over translucent fills. Open ?theme=cupertino to see the chrome.
demo.threeEndProofLead: Even if this window is wide, the 320px box below still uses phone chrome. If components followed the window, the sidebar would appear. It does not — it follows the box.
demo.threeEndProofWide: Wide container (same width as the 1280 viewport) → sidebar appears. That is container-driven.
demo.threeEndProofNarrow: Narrow 320px container (viewport still 1280) → sidebar hides, Dialog becomes a bottom sheet.
demo.threeEndBannerPhone: Phone · nav=TabBar · overlay=ActionSheet from the bottom · density=comfortable ≥44px
demo.threeEndBannerTablet: Tablet · nav=collapsible sidebar + TabBar · overlay=centered Dialog · density=standard
demo.threeEndBannerDesktop: Desktop · nav=persistent sidebar (no TabBar) · overlay=centered Dialog · density=compact
demo.threeEndBannerProof: Proof · viewport 1280, box 320 · Dialog / AppShell follow the container, not the window
demo.threeEndOverlayHintPhone: Below 768px the native overlay is ActionSheet (bottom sheet). The same task is a centered Dialog on desktop.
demo.threeEndOverlayHintWide: From 768px the native overlay is a centered Dialog. The same task is an ActionSheet on phone.
demo.threeEndPointerNote: Pointer vs touch: hover styles apply only when (hover: hover). This machine hover={hover}, fine pointer={fine}. A virtual keyboard shrinks the viewport; keep inputs out from under a fixed tab bar.
demo.threeEndCollapseBody: Phones have no reliable hover, so the desktop hover Popover becomes click-to-expand here.
demo.threeEndVkbd: Virtual-keyboard trial (focus to raise the keyboard)
demo.threeEndResizeHint: Drag the window: ~390 TabBar + ActionSheet + 44px; ~768 sidebar + TabBar; ~1280 persistent sidebar, no TabBar.
demo.threeEndFreezeSummary: Demo freeze (VR snapshots) — fixed iframe widths, not product behavior
demo.threeEndFreezeLead: The frames below freeze width at 390 / 768 / 1280 for visual-regression only. The product path is the full-window shell above, driven by window size.
demo.blindKicker: No theme name in chrome. Do not use DevTools.
demo.blindLead: You will see 16 screens (8 official homage themes × 2, shuffled). Pick which theme it is, or unknown. Correctness is not shown until the end. A session count is not a published recognition rate.
demo.blindDoneLead: This session counted {correct} of {total} correct. That number is not a published recognition rate. Do not type a fake percent into the kanban.
demo.blindExportHint: Save as docs/project/reports/盲测结果.json after a real human run. Owner: 待指定. Never invent a percentage.
